name: Coconut Chutney
summary: Fresh coconut, green chilli and roasted gram. Add water a little at a time for the texture you like.
precautions: Use the small chutney jar; do not exceed its working fill level.
Pulse in short bursts and scrape down only with the grinder switched off.
Water amount is a starting suggestion; adjust gradually.

name: Peanut Chutney
summary: Roasted peanuts with garlic and chilli; keep it coarse or add water for a dip.
precautions: Check that peanuts are cool before grinding.
Use short pulses; do not pack the jar tightly.

name: Tomato Chutney
summary: A tangy cooked tomato chutney. Cool ingredients before blending.
precautions: Never blend hot ingredients in a sealed jar.
Do not add extra liquid unless needed.

name: Ginger-Garlic Paste
summary: Everyday aromatic paste. Add only enough water to help the blades catch.
precautions: Cut ingredients into small pieces first.
Refrigerate promptly and use clean utensils.

name: Green Coriander Chutney
summary: Coriander, mint and lemon for a bright, versatile chutney.
precautions: Wash herbs and drain excess water.
Add liquid gradually to avoid a runny result.

name: Dry Masala Blend
summary: A small-batch dry spice blend. Grind only fully dry, cooled ingredients.
precautions: Use the dry chutney jar only; keep jar and ingredients completely dry.
Let roasted spices cool fully before grinding.
Use short pulses to reduce heat and preserve aroma.

name: Coffee Beans
summary: Small quantity dry grind. Texture depends on bean, quantity and pulse duration.
precautions: Check the grinder manufacturer permits dry grinding in this jar.
Do not exceed the jar's fill line; stop to inspect grind between bursts.

name: Almond Powder
summary: Use chilled, dry almonds for a coarse meal; long grinding can release oil.
precautions: Use short pulses and allow the jar to cool between bursts.
Stop before the almonds turn oily or form a paste.

name: Banana Smoothie
summary: A simple small-batch smoothie. Add liquid first and avoid hot ingredients.
precautions: Use the liquidising jar and stay below its working capacity.
Do not process hot liquids in a sealed jar.

name: Mango Lassi
summary: Yogurt and ripe mango blended until smooth; adjust thickness to taste.
precautions: Use the liquidising jar and do not exceed its working capacity.
Add liquid gradually and avoid hot ingredients.

name: Tomato Puree
summary: A quick puree for sauces. Cut tomatoes and use short runs to control texture.
precautions: Do not exceed the jar working capacity.
Use cooled ingredients; do not process hot liquids.

name: Onion Chop
summary: Coarse chop for cooking. Use the chopper jar if supplied with this appliance.
precautions: Use the jar/blade assembly specified by the appliance manual.
Pulse briefly and inspect after each burst to avoid pureeing.
